purpose: Additional original sources for the independent MIXUE network-day bounds check; preserves sources.json unchanged.

sources.title: 2025 Interim Report (Chinese)
sources.publication_date_basis: Not independently verified in this supplemental review; the linked file path alone is not treated as publication-date evidence.
sources.limitation: Group franchise network and group merchandise sales, not a proven constant-brand or constant-channel scope. Goods delivery and acceptance is not terminal consumer sale timing.

sources.title: 2025 Annual Report
sources.publication_date_basis: Not independently verified in this supplemental review; the linked file path alone is not treated as publication-date evidence.
sources.limitation: 1,354 is the acquired franchise-store count at completion; subsequent openings and closures are included in annual flows. It is not 2026 H1 average stores or store-days.

bounds_condition: Disclosed bridge must cover all network entry and exit events. Arithmetic closure does not prove economic-event completeness.
date_caution: Where publication metadata was not independently checked, the date remains document-linked rather than separately verified. No claim of exhaustive latest-announcement coverage.
